'''Casey Johnson''' (GEMP handle '''Maul1985''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> finished '''#49''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] and '''#54''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 54). <ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026).
